luiskr.com / core/utils/motion/scroll-spring / springScrollTo

function springScrollTo(track, target, animClass, onSettle?, instant?): void

Defined in: core/utils/motion/scroll-spring.ts:107

Spring-scrolls track to target scrollLeft. Mid-flight retargets preserve velocity (the organic part — a rapid double-tap nav curves onto the new course instead of restarting). When a spring is already live only the target/onSettle update — the loop keeps its frame cadence.

Parameters

track

Element

The scrolling element (the carousel track).

target

number

Target scrollLeft (px).

animClass

string

Track modifier class that disables CSS snap+smooth while the spring drives.

onSettle?

(() => void) | null

Called once on settle — normal completion path for clone teleports and the isNavigating release.

instant?

boolean = false

Reduced-motion / no-animation escape: writes the target directly, kills any live spring, fires onSettle now.

Returns

void
